title: BTE HKMU
description: This modpack is designed for BTEHKMU that provides powerful building tools and performance enhancements for large-scale realistic city building.
body:
This pack focuses on:

🏗️ Enhanced building tools to improve building efficiency

*   \[Worldedit, Axiom, BTETerraRenderer\]

🌆 Visual improvements that make cities look more realistic without heavily impacting performance

*   \[Distant Horizons with Bliss & Kappa Shaders preinstalled\]

⚙️ Stability and optimization for multiplayer collaboration on large world maps

*   \[Sodium Performance Ecosystem with 50+ enhancing mods \]

🧩 Quality-of-life features tailored for builders rather than survival gameplay

Every mod and configuration is selected to support the needs of real-scale urban recreation, making it easier for builders to focus on accuracy, detail, and teamwork.

Credits

*   Reimagined GUI - Light by amongstreality
*   Smooth Font - 32x \[1.21\] by apt9002
*   Translations for Sodium by robotkoer
*   Bliss Shader setting files credit to Argent
